blocks.text:
Arrival in Caracas. Meeting with the Russian-speaking guide and transfer to the hotel. Check-in and a short rest.

In the afternoon, enjoy a sightseeing tour of downtown Caracas, including the Capitol, the Cathedral, Casa Amarilla, the birthplace of Simón Bolívar and the National Pantheon.

Continue to the El Mirador viewpoint for panoramic views of the modern business district and a stop at the Caracas Sphere sculpture. Lunch in a traditional restaurant is not included. Return to the hotel.

provenance.rationale: The approved English Word Day 1 itinerary includes the guided city tour and El Mirador visit as scheduled services; these details take precedence over the shorter RU site text and the exact Word guide language is retained.
The exact city name Caracas is obtained by removing Day 1 from the Word itinerary heading.

blocks.text: Days 2–3: Ávila National Park and Colonia Tovar

provenance.rationale: The approved Word programme schedules Ávila National Park and Colonia Tovar on days 2 and 3, replacing the outdated RU free-days heading.

blocks.text:
Day 2: After breakfast, drive by 4x4 into Ávila National Park for views over Caracas and the Caribbean Sea. Visit the historic Humboldt Hotel, known for its architecture, original mosaics and mountain setting. Lunch at the hotel is available at extra cost. Return to the hotel to rest. Meals: Breakfast.

Day 3: Travel to Colonia Tovar, a mountain settlement founded by German immigrants in 1843. Explore the central square, churches, market and local history museum. An optional agricultural tour with local tastings is available. Lunch in a traditional restaurant is not included. Return to Caracas and rest at the hotel. Meals: Breakfast.

provenance.rationale: The Word 2027 programme specifies included visits on days 2 and 3, unlike the RU optional free-day narrative; the combined text follows its approved sequence and preserves optional lunch and extra activities.
The Word tour starts in Caracas and returns there after the day-three excursion, so the exact city name is the location label.
